name: Financial Institution Identification 11 Choice
definition: Choice between formats for the identification of the financial institution.

NameAndAddress.name: Name And Address
NameAndAddress.definition: Identifies the name and (long) postal address of a financial institution.

BICFI.name: BICFI
BICFI.definition: Identification of the financial institution expressed as a BIC.

ClearingSystemMemberIdentification.name: Clearing System Member Identification
ClearingSystemMemberIdentification.definition: Choice of identifier for a clearing system member, as assigned by the clearing system. In some clearing systems, the accounts of the clearing system members are also assigned an identifier.

ProprietaryIdentification.name: Proprietary Identification
ProprietaryIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier, as assigned to a financial institution using a proprietary identification scheme.
